environment: Production native CJS preview; Chromium touch with mock platform ad outcomes
checks: a legal final touch creates a missed-target loss with undo and configured continuation
home and a fresh native mount restore loss to its result screen
touch undo from loss restores board and candidates with one use consumed
dismissed platform ad outcome preserves the loss and unused continuation
failed platform ad outcome preserves the loss and unused continuation
a confirmed ad result received in the background preserves pause until explicit resume
only explicit SDK completion applies exactly two supplemental groups and clears prior undo
a completed continuation survives remount without a second grant
an already confirmed persisted SDK receipt recovers once across interruption
